gaps: No verified source-stated climate-to-violence or conflict-to-adaptation chain was found. This is a search limitation, not proof of absence.

Asparuhovo findings describe differentiated Roma housing exposure and municipal prevention gaps in one 2014 case, not ethnic propensity to conflict. Reported casualties were not independently reconciled.

Municipality populations in disaster-declaration statistics are not counts of people directly harmed. Water-system loss indicators have varied reference periods and are not climate-attributable losses.
A health projection with no source-stated period was excluded rather than assigning a working horizon. Current comparable local vulnerability information remains incomplete.

executive_assessment.text: Historical drought and heat vary across Dobrudzha, the Danube corridor and Struma/Mesta valleys. Asparuhovo provides one dated example of unequal housing losses, not a national household risk ranking.

Recent government analysis identifies named-town network losses, peripheral-settlement service constraints and irrigation limitations. Climate pressure is one contributor alongside infrastructure and governance.
Commission findings identify risk-information, implementation and coordination gaps; program allocations and municipal commitments are capacities, not proven outcomes.
